summary: A single AnsibleAutomationPlatformRestore now creates the AutomationControllerRestore, AutomationHubRestore and EDARestore objects; create it from All Instances with a new instance name, Backup Source CR and the backup name, then check pods are Running or Completed.
questions: How do I restore AAP on OpenShift?
Do I need a restore object for each AAP component?
How do I know an AAP restore finished?

answer_card.title: Restore AAP on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
Operators > Installed Operators > AAP > *All Instances* > Create New > *Ansible Automation Platform Restore*:
- *Name*: restore name
- *New Ansible Automation Platform Name*: instance name
- *Backup Source*: CR
- *Backup name*: the backup's name

It creates the controller, hub and EDA restores. Done when all pods in Workloads > Pods are *Running* or *Completed*.
